_doc: The turn loop as data (A3). step_turn iterates this ordered phase list and dispatches each phase to its byte-verified sim function; reordering/disabling a phase here changes the turn without recompiling. A golden-master test asserts this pipeline is identical to the reference sim::step_turn. reads/writes name the schema columns each phase touches (for the reverse index + the B5 turn editor).

phases.note: Each colony updates SoL / build progress / growth.
European supply-accumulator drift, once per turn.
Each power advances its own Europe dock; crosses = base + its colonies' output.
King's REF budget accrual + unit purchase.
Refresh move points and execute standing orders (all owners).
Advance year/season at end of turn.
